evidence.reference_title: EIF2AK2 Missense Variants Associated with Early Onset Generalized Dystonia.
evidence.snippet: We identified EIF2AK2 variants implicated in early onset generalized dystonia, which can be dominantly or recessively inherited, or occur de novo.

nodes.description: EIF2AK2 encodes the double-stranded-RNA-activated protein kinase PKR, an eIF2-alpha kinase of the integrated stress response. Dystonia-associated missense variants lie in functional domains of PKR and produce abnormally prolonged, enhanced activation of the kinase rather than loss of activity.

nodes.description: Patient-derived fibroblasts carrying EIF2AK2 dystonia variants show abnormally enhanced and prolonged PKR-mediated phosphorylation of eIF2-alpha (Ser51) and sustained activation of the integrated stress response. A dysregulated eIF2-alpha pathway is a convergence point shared with other monogenic dystonias (DYT-PRKRA, DYT-TOR1A, DYT-THAP1).
